title: StyleSync-AI Powered Personal Fashion Recommender
description: AI-powered personal stylist that recommends outfits based on your photo.
longDescription:
If fashion were an exam, we would probably score in negative marks 🤦‍♂️😂

So me and my friend Aayush Pandya decided to let AI handle our style sense, and that’s how StyleSync came to life 👗✨

Upload a photo, and our model analyzes it to detect your age, gender & skin tone, then recommends outfits that actually suit you — your personal stylist, but smarter (and less judgmental 😅). For this, we trained the model on 44,000 images from the FashionCLIP dataset available on Kaggle, using CNNs to ensure accurate predictions.

We also built:
✅ Fashion fest explorer (India)
✅ Smooth shopping + order emails via Nodemailer
✅ Admin panel to manage shop, events & queries

title: SatvaFarm: Plant Disease Detection and Government Scheme Portal
description: A web application to help farmers detect plant diseases by uploading images and to provide information about relevant government schemes. It also includes a knowledge base with articles about agriculture.
longDescription: AgriCare is a comprehensive platform for farmers. It leverages machine learning for plant disease detection. Users can upload images of their plants and get instant feedback on their health. The application also serves as a portal for discovering and applying for government schemes related to agriculture. A rich knowledge base with articles and guides is available to keep farmers informed about the latest agricultural practices. The platform requires user authentication and has a verification system using ID proofs. The frontend is a modern single-page application built with React.

title: Personal Health Tracker
description: A Java-based application to track health, book appointments, calculate BMI, and maintain patient records.
longDescription:
A Java-based Personal Health Tracker system that allows users to monitor and manage their fitness, nutrition, and overall wellness through personalized data tracking and analytics.

Key Features:
- User Profile Management: Create and customize individual health profiles with personal details and goals.
- Activity Tracking: Log daily physical activities like steps, workouts, and calories burned.
- Health Metrics Dashboard: View real-time health metrics like weight, BMI, heart rate, and sleep patterns.
- Reminders & Notifications: Receive reminders for workouts, meals, hydration, and medication.
